name: Slow cooker cashew chicken
title: Cashew chicken (fakeaway)

steps.text: Chop the chicken, onion and peppers into chunks (chunky so they do not shrivel), chop 3 spring onions, mince 4 garlic cloves.
Everything into the slow cooker except the cornflour and the serving bits. LOW for 7 to 8 hours (or HIGH for 3 to 4).
steps.short: All in, slow cooker LOW 8 h

steps.text: Start the basmati rice (600 g cooked).
Stir in the cornflour (mixed with a splash of water) to thicken. Add another handful of cashews and some fresh spring onions.
Chop 2 spring onions and get the sesame seeds out for serving.
Serve over the rice, topped with spring onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

prep: Sauces measured: soy (dark + light), honey, hoisin, rice vinegar
ingredients: to serve: 2 spring onions, 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 600 g basmati rice (cooked)
source: Bored of Lunch (Instagram), sent by the owner 11 Oct 2026
equipment: a small bowl for the sauce
